Word play — these mean the same thing: Bronchoprovocation test = Methacholine Challenge; Cardio-Respiratory arrest = Full Arrest; Chronic Hypercarbia = CO2 Retainer; Controlled O2 concentration = Specific FiO2; Heart Failure = Cardiac Arrest = Cardiac Failure (O2 does NOT help!); HFNC = VapoTherm or Optiflow (Fisher & Paykel) (NOT HFNC up to 15L); Induction Agents = Anesthetic Meds; Imbalance = Mismatch; Inclusion Criteria = Indication; Liberation Parameters = Weaning; Long-standing = Chronic; Mainstay = Best suited for / Therapy of choice (1st choice); NIPPV = NPPV = NIV = BiPAP; No purposeful movement to command = Unconscious; Oxygen-induced Hypoventilation = Knocked out the Hypoxic Drive; PBW (predicted body weight) = IBW (ideal body weight); Rapid Response Team (RRT) = Medical Emergency Team (MET); SIMV = IMV

Word play — trick words to watch for: Adequate; Aggressive pain control does NOT mean too much meds; At least; Blunted; Changes to treatment plan and “actual orders” are NOT the same; Eliminate does NOT mean Filter (Lungs vs. Kidneys); Except; First; Laryngotracheal (Injury); Mechanical Ventilation = Vent  or  BiPAP; it is NOT specific to Vents only; Most commonly used; Most likely; Next; Nonpulmonary; Not; Observation; Obliterated; Precedence (Importance); Recommend at this time; Routinely; Severe; Significance
